name: broad_macro_cross_asset
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Wednesday September 23, 2026. Scope: Macro & cross-asset.

Window: Wednesday September 23, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Wednesday September 23, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
- US index closes: S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite, Dow, Russell 2000, PHLX SOX (% change).
- Rates/FX: 2-yr and 10-yr Treasury yields, DXY; Treasury auctions.
- Economic data released: actual vs consensus vs prior.
- Fed/FOMC decisions and named speaker quotes; ECB/BoE/BoJ/PBoC actions.
- Commodities: WTI, Brent, natural gas, gold, silver, copper (price, % change); OPEC.
- Crypto: Bitcoin, Ether (price, % change); SEC/CFTC/Congress crypto actions; ETF flows.
- Policy/geopolitics: tariffs, export controls, sanctions, wars moving oil or risk assets.

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## US Index Closes [Macro]

- **S&P 500** closed at 7,706.03, down 58.61 points, or 0.75%, on Wednesday, September 23, 2026. (Yahoo Finance)
- **Nasdaq Composite** closed at 26,936.04, down 308.24 points, or 1.13%. (Yahoo Finance)
- **Dow Jones Industrial Average** closed at 51,511.59, down 352.10 points, or 0.68%. (Yahoo Finance)
- **Russell 2000** closed at 2,838.66, down 51.26 points, or 1.77%. (Yahoo Finance)
- The **PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX)** closing level and percentage change were not available in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)

## Rates and FX [Macro]

- The **2-year Treasury yield** rose 11.4 basis points to 4.891%; it reached an intraday high of 4.947%, its highest level since May 2024. (Reuters)
- The **10-year Treasury yield** rose 13.89 basis points to 5.106%, its highest level since 2007 and its largest one-day increase since April 2025. (Reuters)
- The 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.135% intraday, according to CNBC. (CNBC)
- The **DXY** closing level and percentage change were not available in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)
- A **5-year Treasury auction** was listed on the September 23 calendar, but the auction’s high yield, bid-to-cover ratio, and indirect allotment were not available in the gathered results. (Investing.com)

## Economic Data [Macro / Calendar]

- The **S&P Global Flash US Composite PMI Output Index** rose to 58.4 in September from 56.0 in August, reaching its highest level since July 2021. (Reuters)
- The September **Flash Services PMI** was 58.7, while the **Flash Manufacturing PMI** was 57.0; consensus estimates and the prior monthly readings for each subindex were not provided in the gathered results. (XTB)
- The September PMI readings indicated that US business activity reached a more-than-five-year high, according to S&P Global’s release cited by Reuters. (Reuters)
- The **Richmond Fed Manufacturing Index** fell to -2 in September from 4 in the prior month; consensus was not provided in the gathered results. (Investing.com)
- Euro-area preliminary consumer confidence declined to -16.5 from -15.5; consensus was not provided in the gathered results. (Investing.com)

## Federal Reserve and Other Central Banks [Macro]

- The gathered results reported that several Federal Reserve officials emphasized the need to return inflation to target, but they did not identify the speakers or provide direct quotations. (Reuters)
- Market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate increase at the October meeting rose after the September PMI data; the specific probability was not provided. (Reuters)
- No confirmed ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, or People’s Bank of China decision published within the specified window was identified in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)

## Commodities [Commodities]

- **WTI crude oil** settled at $92.16 per barrel, up approximately 1.8%. (CNBC)
- Another Reuters market report placed US crude at $91.87 per barrel, up 1.49%; the difference reflects timing or contract-data variation. (Reuters)
- **Brent crude oil** settled at $103.08 per barrel, up approximately 3.9%. (CNBC)
- Another Reuters market report placed Brent at $101.62 per barrel, up 2.39%; the difference reflects timing or contract-data variation. (Reuters)
- **Gold** was reported at $4,287.05 per ounce, down 1.55%, in a Reuters market update. (Reuters)
- Another market close reported gold at $4,322.20 per ounce, up $3.80, or 0.09%; the conflicting figures were not reconciled in the gathered results. (Yahoo Finance)
- Closing prices and percentage changes for **natural gas, silver, and copper** were not available in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)
- No confirmed OPEC decision or statement published within the specified window was identified in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)

## Crypto [Crypto]

- **Bitcoin** was reported at $84,413.93, down $1,707.95, or 1.98%. (Yahoo Finance)
- **Ether** price and percentage change were not available in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)
- US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $998.95 million of net inflows on September 21, led by BlackRock’s IBIT with $381.4 million; the flow date was outside the specified September 23 reporting window but was reported on September 23. (CoinStats)
- US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded approximately $269.98 million of net inflows on September 21, according to the same report. (CoinStats)
- Combined Bitcoin and Ethereum spot-ETF inflows were approximately $1.27 billion for the September 21 session. (CoinStats)
- A report citing Galaxy Research said US spot Bitcoin ETFs became net positive for 2026 after an inflow day of nearly $1 billion. (Investing.com)
- BlackRock’s ETHA led the reported Ethereum ETF inflows, which totaled approximately $270 million for the session. (Investing.com)
- CME Group announced Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures on September 23, with trading scheduled to begin October 19, 2026. (CoinStats)
- No confirmed SEC, CFTC, or congressional crypto action published within the specified window was identified in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)

## Oil and Geopolitics [Geopolitics]

- Iran’s president said Tehran would not surrender to US pressure, according to a Reuters market report accompanying the September 23 selloff. (Reuters)
- The Iran-related statement was reported alongside higher oil prices and higher Treasury yields; no additional confirmed tariff, export-control, or sanctions action was identified in the gathered results. (Reuters)
- No confirmed new war-related development, tariff action, or semiconductor export-control measure published within the specified window was identified in the gathered results. (Source unavailable)
